care.pods: Store capsules in a cool, dry place. Descale your machine every three months. Used capsules can be recycled where aluminium capsule recycling is available.
care.coffee: Keep beans in an airtight container away from light and heat. Grind just before brewing and use water just off the boil.
care.machine: Descale every three months, empty the water tank daily and rinse the drip tray. Use filtered water in hard-water areas.
care.accessory: Hand wash with mild soap. Check the label on the product for dishwasher and heat guidance.
care.gift: Store in a cool, dry place until gifting.
